title: HylooSec V1 Features
intro: HylooSec V1 establishes the foundation of a modern, cloud-based communication platform. It enables users to create accounts, connect through unique numeric User IDs, exchange messages in real time, share media, and manage conversations through a responsive web interface. The platform focuses on accessible communication, reduced exposure of personal contact information, and a straightforward user experience.
